abstract: Evaluates aerial LiDAR vegetation penetrability and structural forest canopy profiles
system_message:
You are the Remote Sensing Specialist (RS), responsible for evaluating aerial LiDAR vegetation penetrability, structural forest canopy profiles, and UAV photogrammetry parameters for canopy survey transects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drone Photogrammetry（ORTHO）
information_points.content:
RS-ORTHO-HKD：For the Uatumã River Highland Transect, the UAV continuous canopy photogrammetry swaths have an orthomosaic resolution ground sample distance of 2.5 cm/px.
RS-ORTHO-X03：For the Jaú River Floodplain Transect, the UAV continuous canopy photogrammetry swaths have an orthomosaic resolution ground sample distance of 5.0 cm/px.
RS-ORTHO-MGW：For the Rio Negro Upper Basin Transect, the UAV continuous canopy photogrammetry swaths have an orthomosaic resolution ground sample distance of 10.0 cm/px.

information_points.title: Evaluates aerial LiDAR vegetation penetrability and structural forest canopy profiles（LIDAR）
information_points.content:
RS-LIDAR-590：For the Rio Negro Upper Basin Transect, LiDAR canopy-penetration compliance is true, achieving at least 30 ground returns per square meter through multistory foliage across the transect survey corridor crown coverage.
RS-LIDAR-WO2：For the Jaú River Floodplain Transect, LiDAR canopy-penetration compliance is false, failing to attain at least 30 ground returns per square meter through multistory foliage across the transect survey corridor crown coverage.
RS-LIDAR-EYF：For the Uatumã River Highland Transect, LiDAR canopy-penetration compliance is true, successfully reaching at least 30 ground returns per square meter through multistory foliage across the transect survey corridor crown coverage.
